description.value: Wells Gray Guest Ranch is a Western-style guest ranch situated on Clearwater Valley Road, the primary corridor leading into Wells Gray Provincial Park — one of BC's most dramatic wilderness destinations. The ranch operates as an all-in-one booking platform for accommodations, horseback riding, and dining, including an on-site saloon. Its position on the Valley Road makes it a natural staging point for cyclists exploring the park.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's pre-fetched content rendered only navigation menu items and page titles from what appears to be a JavaScript-heavy booking platform, yielding almost no substantive prose about amenities. The navigation pages do reveal on-site dining infrastructure (Saloon, Dining Booking, Drink Menu, Kitchen) and a 'Wifi Portal' / 'Wells Gray Park Wifi Portal' page — sufficient to infer Wi-Fi and on-site evening food with moderate confidence. No cycling-specific amenity details (bike storage, tools, laundry, etc.) appear anywhere in the captured content, so all those fields remain null.
concerns: Website content rendered only navigation/menu items — the underlying booking platform is heavily JavaScript-driven and the pre-fetcher could not capture substantive page content. Amenity claims are largely unverifiable from this fetch.
No phone number present in OSM record or on the captured website pages.
Address confirmation against website was not possible due to absence of contact details in fetched content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The ranch is a legitimate accommodation on the Wells Gray Provincial Park corridor and a plausible WWC listing, but the website's JavaScript-rendered content failed to expose any cycling-specific amenity details, leaving both required criteria (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) unconfirmed. Direct outreach is needed before including.
enrichment_extras.notes: Property is located approximately 35 km north of Clearwater on Clearwater Valley Road, placing it within easy cycling distance of Wells Gray Provincial Park attractions. On-site horseback riding and a saloon suggest a self-contained ranch experience.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site saloon and dining reservation system visible in site navigation (Saloon, Dining Booking, Dining Reservations, Drink Menu pages)
